Beta candidate. Quick test, faults, readings, live data, guided tests and experimental service functions.

**New in 0.99.30:**
- **Every model visible on smaller screens.** In the Garage, the car families are now compact buttons instead of one full-width row each, with a heading over the model list. On a laptop-sized window the 13 families used to push the model list off the bottom of the screen, so some owners only saw the first model of their car (for example the E46 323i, not the M3).

**Downloads:** unzip and run Klemme15 (Klemme15.exe on Windows). The command-line tool is in the cli folder. EDIABAS mode (your own BMW files) is included in every build.

Earlier versions: [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/Expos-AI/Klemme15/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).
